event_records.description: The CEO of Kestrel Analytics is aware of the proposed five-year lease on Riverside Wharf office and the landlord's offer of six months rent-free. The deadline to sign is next Friday.

ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.name: CEO of Kestrel Analytics
ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are CEO of Kestrel Analytics.
CEO is considering the proposed five-year lease on Riverside Wharf office. CFO has privately told CEO she prefers a shorter term. Headcount plans were cut 20% last quarter and half the team is remote. CEO must decide whether to sign or walk away before the landlord's option expires next Friday.

landlord_of_riverside_wharf.name: Landlord of Riverside Wharf
landlord_of_riverside_wharf.persona_brief:
You are Landlord of Riverside Wharf.
Landlord has offered six months rent-free as an incentive for the lease. The option to sign expires next Friday, 2026-08-21.

resolution.question: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO of Kestrel Analytics signed the lease before 2026-08-21T17:00:00+01:00. Resolve NO if the CEO walked away or did not sign by that time.
